subject: Closeboard sync: sprint gating, runbook owners, rollback triggers
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Ravi Patel <ravi@cardioworks.com>, CardioWorks Ops <prodops@cardioworks.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Closeboard sync: sprint gating, runbook owners, rollback triggers

Morning all — quick weekly checkpoint ahead of the cutover window next Thursday (2027-09-16). Goal: confirm owners for every step in the runbook, validate rollback triggers, and freeze the pre-cutover checklist by EOD Wednesday.

Top-line status:
- Launch date: 2027-09-16 (target 02:00–04:00 PT)
- Pre-cutover checklist: draft attached (20270912_precutover_checklist.xlsx)
- Runbook: runbook_v1.3.pdf attached; will be the canonical copy going into the dry-run on Tuesday.

Immediate asks (owners + due):
1) Canary capacity & throttling config — owner: Ben Carter — due: 2027-09-14 17:00 PT
2) DB read-only window and data retention check — owner: Karthik Iyer — due: 2027-09-14 12:00 PT
3) Runbook step verification (play-by-play) — owner: Laura Bennett — due: 2027-09-15 10:00 PT
4) Rollback decision matrix and acceptance criteria — owner: Marcus Lin — due: 2027-09-14 20:00 PT

Rollback triggers we plan to use (draft):
- Error rate > 5% for 10 consecutive minutes on production routes
- Latency P95 increases > 2x baseline for longer than 5 minutes
- Data integrity alerts (checksum failures, failed writes)

Notes / constraints from CardioWorks side are welcome — particularly on allowed maintenance windows and SLA tolerance for the canary period. I linked the shared drive doc below; Ben/Marcus — please annotate the runbook where you make changes so we have a clean diff.

Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/rdw/closeboard/RDW-3421
HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deal/12345

Attachments: 20270912_precutover_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet), runbook_v1.3.pdf (PDF)

Thanks — S
--
Sean Gallagher

From: Ravi Patel <ravi@cardioworks.com>

Cc: CardioWorks Ops <prodops@cardioworks.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-12T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Closeboard sync: sprint gating, runbook owners, rollback triggers

Thanks, Sean — this is helpful. A couple quick points from our side: 
- The only maintenance window we can accept without extra approvers is 02:00–05:00 PT on weekdays; the 02:00–04:00 window you propose fits.
- For rollback triggers, we need an explicit data-loss vs performance split. We have zero-tolerance for failed writes to the telemetry DB; if any failed writes are detected we require an automatic rollback unless a named technical lead signs off.

Action items we own:
- Provide final whitelist of IPs for canary by 2027-09-14 10:00 PT — owner: CardioWorks Ops (prodops@cardioworks.com)
- Confirm retention settings and sampling windows for telemetry (to ensure parity) — owner: Ravi Patel — due: 2027-09-15 12:00 PT

I'll review the runbook later today and ping with comments. One ask: can you add an explicit contact line under each rollback step that names the person authorized to approve a rollback (we prefer a single point of contact per step)?

On it — quick updates against Sean's asks:
- Canary capacity & throttling config: I will provision the canary pools and a throttling policy with a 10% production replica. Planned deployment: 2027-09-14 09:00–11:00 PT (so we can test routing and throttles). I'll attach the canary config to the Drive doc after the provisioning completes. (Action: Ben — verify 10% replication and warm KV caches.)
- I'll add explicit contact lines to each rollback step as Ravi requested. Proposed SRO (service response owner) for rollback approval: Marcus Lin (for DB/ingest concerns) or Ben Carter (for routing/traffic concerns).
- I'll also run a quick smoke test script against the canary once up; that will surface early checksum/data issues.

New action item: update the pre-cutover checklist with the canary smoke-test pass/fail matrix — owner: Ben Carter — due 2027-09-14 18:00 PT

I'll post the config link in Drive when ready.

Ben

Appreciate the quick responses — closing the loop for today: 
- Owners and due dates captured; I'll update the MAP tracker and lock the runbook at 08:00 PT on 2027-09-15 (freeze). Please do not make edits to runbook_v1.3 after that time; annotate in the Drive if you need a follow-up change.
- Marcus, Ben: please confirm SRO assignment in Drive by 2027-09-13 12:00 PT.
- CardioWorks: noted on the data-loss policy; we'll add the explicit contact line to each rollback step and flag data-integrity triggers as immediate rollback.

Next sync: dry-run walk-through on 2027-09-14 11:00 PT (30m) — calendar invite to follow. If there's anything high-risk you want on the agenda, drop it in the HubSpot deal record under 'precutover_risks'.

Thanks — S
